extracted.intended_audience: visual, literary, and performing artists seeking grant funding (primarily U.S. context)
extracted.subtask_description: A practical how-to guide for artists on finding funding and writing effective grant proposals, including preparing artist statements, work samples, budgets, and relationships with funders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction
rubrics_metrics.description: Prefatory material orienting readers to the book's approach to finding funds and writing proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find the money
rubrics_metrics.description: How to locate potential funding sources appropriate for your artistic practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Start your research with you
rubrics_metrics.description: Begin grant-research by clarifying your own work, goals, and eligibility before searching funders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make grant writing work for you
rubrics_metrics.description: Strategies to integrate grant-writing into your workflow so it supports (rather than distracts from) your art practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build your team
rubrics_metrics.description: Assemble collaborators, mentors, or administrative support to strengthen proposals and project delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decipher the applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn to read and understand application forms, eligibility rules, review criteria, and funder expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Write your proposal, step by step
rubrics_metrics.description: A stepwise walkthrough for composing the components of a grant proposal (narrative, goals, methods, timeline, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Stand out from the crowd
rubrics_metrics.description: Tactics for differentiating your proposal and making it memorable to reviewers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Craft your artist statement, bio, and résumé
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on writing concise, compelling artist statements, professional bios, and CVs/resumés tailored to funders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Showcase your art with a stellar work sample
rubrics_metrics.description: How to select, prepare, and present work samples that best demonstrate the strengths of your practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget fearlessly
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparing realistic, defensible budgets and budget narratives that reflect project needs and funder rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make friends with funders
rubrics_metrics.description: Building relationships with program officers and funders to improve fit and understanding of expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fundraise strategically
rubrics_metrics.description: Broader fundraising strategies beyond grants, and how to plan funding mixes strategically over time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overcome psychological roadblocks
rubrics_metrics.description: Addressing emotional and cognitive barriers to applying (fear of rejection, procrastination, impostor syndrome).

rubrics_metrics.name: Epilogue: Make art
rubrics_metrics.description: Final reflections encouraging continuing artistic practice alongside fundraising efforts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix A: Where to find grants and residencies
rubrics_metrics.description: Resource lists and directories for locating grant programs and artist residencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix B: Books and websites about grant writing
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommended further reading and online resources to develop grant-writing skills.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix C: Additional resources to support your career
rubrics_metrics.description: Supplementary career-development resources relevant to artists seeking funding and professional support.
